name: flip_eligible
description: TRUE only when a shop flip was genuinely appropriate: the vehicle needed repair and was heading to a shop that is not ours. Applies to BOTH competitor_repair and car_repair destinations. FALSE for lockout, fuel, jump start, single flat tire and winch-out-only calls; for vehicles going to a residence; for vehicles already heading to one of our shops; and for AAA-branded destinations.

name: flip_outcome
description: Outcome of the flip attempt. SUCCESS if customer redirected to our shop, FAILED if all 3 offers declined, NOT_ATTEMPTED if destination was not competitor_repair.

name: offer_1_result
description: Result of the first flip offer (Convenience + Value). ACCEPTED, DECLINED, or NOT_ATTEMPTED.

name: offer_2_result
description: Result of the second flip offer (Urgency + Priority Service). ACCEPTED, DECLINED, or NOT_ATTEMPTED.

name: offer_3_result
description: Result of the third flip offer (Financial Incentive + Social Proof). ACCEPTED, DECLINED, or NOT_ATTEMPTED.

name: convini_link_sent
description: Was the CONVINIcar app download link sent to the customer via SMS?

name: convini_sell_type
description: Type of CONVINIcar pitch used. SOFT for Scenario A, MEDIUM for Scenario B, HARD for Scenario C/D.

name: corrections_made
description: Free text summary of any corrections made during confirmation (e.g., pickup address, vehicle details, etc.).

name: nearest_our_shop
description: Name of the nearest owned shop to the customer's destination (from dispatch data).

name: destination_type
description: Where the vehicle was actually being taken. Use exactly one of: competitor_repair, car_repair, auto_body, residence, residential_unknown, our_shop, aaa_branded, unknown. competitor_repair = a named chain, franchise or dealership service centre (Firestone, Midas, a brand dealership). car_repair = an independent or unbranded local repair shop. auto_body = collision or body work. residence / residential_unknown = a home or driveway. our_shop = already one of our own shops. aaa_branded = a AAA-branded facility. unknown only when the transcript does not say.

name: call_summary
description: Write a 1-3 sentence summary of the call based on the call transcript. Should capture the important information and actions taken during the call.

name: call_successful
description: Evaluate whether the agent had a successful call with the user. For a successful call, the agent should have a complete conversation with user, finished the task, and have not ran into technical issues, or caused user frustration. Besides, the agent was not blocked by a call screen or encountered voicemail.

name: user_sentiment
description: Evaluate user's sentiment, mood and satisfaction level.
